persona: Online t-shirt shop buyer judging sellability at $50 and print feasibility

designs.why: Reads instantly from 3 m: bold serif PASTA headline, tidy 4x4 grid, consistent confident line weight, clear labels, genuinely hand-drawn feel, and a witty field-guide concept that suits a gift-y foodie tee. One ink, clean heavy strokes with no halftone or tiny hairlines, so it screen-prints well. Weak spots: the dense interior hatching on spaghetti, radiatori and campanelle will clog a bit at tee scale, and the full 28x37 cm block is a big, ink-heavy print. Rows are not perfectly balanced in visual weight, with lasagne and campanelle sprawling to the edge.
designs.fix: Thin out the finest interior hatch lines and open up the densest shapes (spaghetti nest, radiatori, campanelle) so they stay crisp in screen-print and read at distance. Optionally trim the print size slightly.
